title: Earliest Possible Day of Full Bloom

monster.name: Botanical Archon
monster.title: Optimizer of Concurrent Growth Days
monster.defeatQuote: Earliest day when every seed has bloomed achieved!

description: You have `n` flower seeds. To plant seed `i`, you need `plantTime[i]` continuous days. Once planted, it takes `growTime[i]` days to bloom (grows concurrently with other activities). Return the earliest possible day where all seeds are blooming.
starterCode:
def earliestFullBloom(plantTime: list[int], growTime: list[int]) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def earliestFullBloom(plantTime: list[int], growTime: list[int]) -> int:
    seeds = sorted(zip(growTime, plantTime), reverse=True)
    curr_day = 0
    max_bloom = 0
    for g, p in seeds:
        curr_day += p
        max_bloom = max(max_bloom, curr_day + g)
    return max_bloom
hints: Greedy strategy: always plant the seed with the longest growth time first.
